sentences: It's important for code to be readable and consistent across the team.
This helps differentiate them from other variables and promotes clarity in your code.
For now, focus on getting comfortable with the codebase and don't hesitate to ask questions.
Before any meeting, ensure you have a clear understanding of the agenda and the desired outcomes.
Prepare any necessary materials and be ready to contribute productively.
This saves time and keeps the meeting focused.
Anticipating potential topics and preparing talking points can ensure that you actively contribute and that the meeting stays on track.
It's also beneficial to set a clear timeline for the meeting and stick to it.
This prevents unnecessary dragging and respects everyone's time.
During the meeting, actively listen and take concise notes.
Focus on the key points and action items.
If you have questions or insights, don't hesitate to speak up, but also be mindful of the time and respect others' contributions.
Also, don't be afraid to ask for clarification if needed.
It's better to briefly pause the meeting to ensure everyone is on the same page than to have misunderstandings later on.
